title: Recovery Limits for Eigenvector Alignment in HDLSS Spiked Covariance Models
summary: In a spiked covariance model, let $\mathcal{H}$ and $\mathcal{B}$ be selected sample and population eigenvector matrices. Their alignment matrix $Ξ=\mathcal{H}^\top\mathcal{B}$ is a latent oracle diagnostic of direction-specific correspondence beyond subspace overlap. We study its uniform pathwise recovery in a nested high-dimensional, low-sample-size experiment with fixed sample size and growing dimension.
